fullDesc: Francis Ford Coppola's The Godfather premiered in March 1972, based on Mario Puzo's novel. It won the Oscar for Best Picture, and Marlon Brando famously declined his Best Actor award.
realFacts: The Godfather Part II followed in 1974 and won Best Picture too
Brando sent Sacheen Littlefeather to decline his Oscar
It was a huge box-office success
It shaped how Hollywood portrayed organised crime
